item.text: [{"task_id":"2f767503","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    target = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    barrier = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    steps = []","    for pair in params['neighbors']:","        steps.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))","    out = grid.copy()","    markers = np.argwhere(grid == marker)","    h, w = grid.shape","    for point in markers:","        r, c = int(point[0]), int(point[1])","        direction = None","        for dr, dc in steps:","            if dr == 0 and dc == 0:","                continue","            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr, nc] == barrier:","                direction = (dr, dc)","                break","        if direction is None:","            continue","        dr, dc = direction","        r, c = r + dr, c + dc","        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:","            if out[r, c] == target and target != bg:","                pending = [(r, c)]","                out[r, c] = bg","                while pending:","                    ar, ac = pending.pop()","                    for br, bc in steps:","                        nr, nc = ar + br, ac + bc","                        if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and out[nr, nc] == target:","                            out[nr, nc] = bg","                            pending.append((nr, nc))","            r, c = r + dr, c + dc","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[7,4,5,9],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"The 9 points through the adjacent 5 toward a straight ray.
